name: AutoByteus NFS Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: 'Normal NFS version (first v0.1.0); no pre-created tag/release required'
        required: true
        type: string
      source_sha:
        description: 'Full reviewed source commit; empty selects this dispatch SHA'
        required: false
        type: string
      candidate_run_id:
        description: 'Exact current build-only run; required for publication'
        required: false
        type: string
      publish:
        description: 'Authorized signed release; field and user testing deferred'
        default: false
        type: boolean
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ inputs.publish && 'nfs-repository-publication' || format('nfs-candidate-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      packages: read
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.tag }}
      source: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.source }}
      mode: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.mode }}
      base: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Release boundary checks
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_nfs_*.py' -v
      - id: prepare
        env:
          TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
          SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}
          CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.candidate_run_id }}
          WANT_PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=()
          if [[ "$WANT_PUBLISH" == true ]]; then args+=(--run-id "$CANDIDATE_RUN"); fi
          python3 packaging/release.py --operation prepare --tag "$TAG" --source-commit "$SOURCE" --directory work "${args[@]}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: steps.prepare.outputs.mode != 'candidate'
        with:
          name: nfs-preflight
          path: work/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  engine-packages:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {runner: ubuntu-24.04, arch: amd64}
          - {runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm, arch: arm64}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build measured engine pair in pinned disposable builder
        env:
          BASE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/engine-output"
          docker run --rm -e BASE="$BASE" \
            -v "$PWD/packaging/engine:/recipe:ro" \
            -v "$RUNNER_TEMP/engine-output:/output" "$BASE" bash -euc '
              sed -i "s/^Types: deb$/Types: deb deb-src/" /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources
              apt-get update
              DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential devscripts fakeroot curl ca-certificates lsb-release
              DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get build-dep -y nfs-ganesha=4.3-8ubuntu1
              useradd -m -u 1001 builder
              install -d -o builder -g builder /work
              su builder -s /bin/bash -c "python3 /recipe/build.py --work /work/source-build --output /work/output --base $BASE"
              cp -a /work/output/. /output/
            '
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: nfs-engine-package-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/engine-output/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  engine-inputs:
    needs: [prepare, engine-packages]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate' && needs.engine-packages.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          pattern: nfs-engine-package-*
          path: engine-parts
      - run: python3 packaging/engine/manifest.py merge --inputs engine-parts/nfs-engine-package-amd64 engine-parts/nfs-engine-package-arm64 --output engine-candidate
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: nfs-engine-inputs
          path: engine-candidate/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  engine:
    needs: [prepare, engine-inputs]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate' && needs.engine-inputs.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: nfs-engine-inputs
          path: engine-candidate
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@c7c53464625b32c7a7e944ae62b3e17d2b600130
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@10e90e3645eae34f1e60eeb005ba3a3d33f178e8
        with:
          context: .
          file: packaging/Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: false
          provenance: false
          sbom: false
          outputs: type=oci,dest=engine.oci.tar
          build-args: |
            UBUNTU_BASE=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.base }}
      - run: python3 packaging/release.py --operation oci --directory engine.oci.tar
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: nfs-oci
          path: engine.oci.tar
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  binaries:
    needs: [prepare, engine-inputs, engine]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && ((needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate' && needs.engine-inputs.result == 'success' && needs.engine.result == 'success') || (needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh' && needs.engine-inputs.result == 'skipped' && needs.engine.result == 'skipped')) }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {runner: macos-15, os: darwin, arch: arm64}
          - {runner: macos-15-intel, os: darwin, arch: amd64}
          - {runner: ubuntu-24.04, os: linux, arch: amd64}
          - {runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm, os: linux, arch: arm64}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        if: needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate'
        with:
          name: nfs-engine-inputs
          path: work/candidate/engine
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        if: needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate'
        with:
          name: nfs-oci
          path: work/candidate
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        if: needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh'
        with:
          name: nfs-preflight
          path: work
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.2'
          cache: false
      - name: Native checks and exact engine metadata (not physical qualification)
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}
          MODE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image=$(python3 packaging/release.py --operation oci --directory work/candidate/engine.oci.tar | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("ghcr.io/autobyteus/autobyteus-nfs@"+json.load(sys.stdin)["index"])')
          # Keep the array nonempty for Mac system Bash 3.2 under nounset.
          args=(--tag "$TAG" --engine-image "$image" --engine-manifest work/candidate/engine/engine-manifest.json --engine-artifacts work/candidate/engine --target "$TARGET" --output cmd/autobyteus-nfs/release.json)
          if [[ "$MODE" == fresh ]]; then args+=(--release --candidate work/candidate); fi
          python3 packaging/release.py "${args[@]}"
          go test -race ./...
          go vet ./...
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_nfs_*.py' -v
          mkdir -p out native
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o out/autobyteus-nfs ./cmd/autobyteus-nfs
          python3 -c 'import os; assert os.path.getsize("out/autobyteus-nfs") <= 100*1024*1024'
          test "$(out/autobyteus-nfs version)" = "$TAG"
          cp cmd/autobyteus-nfs/release.json LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES out/
          cat "$(go env GOROOT)/LICENSE" >> out/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
          if [[ "$TARGET" == linux-* ]]; then cat "work/candidate/engine/${TARGET#linux-}/COPYRIGHT" >> out/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES; fi
      - name: Developer ID and Accepted notarization before public effects
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh'
        env:
          CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.NFS_MAC_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64 }}
          PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.NFS_MAC_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.NFS_MAC_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: bash packaging/sign-macos.sh out/autobyteus-nfs "native/$TARGET-notary.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: ${{ always() && matrix.os == 'darwin' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh' }}
        with:
          name: nfs-signing-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            native/*-notary.json
            native/*-notary-failure.json
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Package four regular members
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: tar -czf "native/autobyteus-nfs-${TAG#v}-${TARGET}.tar.gz" -C out LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES autobyteus-nfs release.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: nfs-native-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: native/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  candidate:
    needs: [prepare, engine-inputs, engine, binaries]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'candidate' && needs.engine-inputs.result == 'success' && needs.engine.result == 'success' && needs.binaries.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: nfs-engine-inputs
          path: retained/engine
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: nfs-oci
          path: retained
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          pattern: nfs-native-*
          path: retained/native
          merge-multiple: true
      - env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}
          SOURCE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
        run: python3 packaging/release.py --operation candidate --directory retained --tag "$TAG" --source-commit "$SOURCE" --workflow-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: nfs-release-candidate
          path: retained/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  payload:
    needs: [prepare, binaries]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh' && needs.binaries.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      artifact: ${{ steps.retain.outputs.artifact-id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: nfs-preflight
          path: work
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          pattern: nfs-native-*
          path: native
          merge-multiple: true
      - env:
          SOURCE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
        run: python3 packaging/release.py --operation payload --directory work/payload --candidate work/candidate --native native --source-commit "$SOURCE" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        id: retain
        with:
          name: nfs-release-payload
          path: work/payload/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
  publish:
    needs: [prepare, binaries, payload]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && ((needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh' && needs.binaries.result == 'success' && needs.payload.result == 'success') || (needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'resume' && needs.binaries.result == 'skipped' && needs.payload.result == 'skipped')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with:
          name: nfs-preflight
          path: work
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        if: needs.prepare.outputs.mode == 'fresh'
        with:
          name: nfs-release-payload
          path: work/payload
      - name: Install digest-preserving registry transport
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends skopeo
          skopeo --version
      - name: Bind retained payload and reconcile publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MODE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}
          ARTIFACT: ${{ needs.payload.outputs.artifact }}
          REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/nfs-registry-auth.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          trap 'rm -f "$REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE"' EXIT
          printf '%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | skopeo login --authfile "$REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE" --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin ghcr.io
          if [[ "$MODE" == fresh ]]; then
            python3 packaging/release.py --operation bind --directory work/payload --candidate work/candidate --artifact-id "$ARTIFACT" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --output work/binding.json
          fi
          python3 packaging/release.py --operation publish --directory work/payload --candidate work/candidate --binding work/binding.json --output publication-receipt.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: nfs-publication-receipt
          path: publication-receipt.json
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
